svg.title: Crowding in seven clusters
svg.desc: Seven globular clusters drawn as they fill the one-degree field, at a common angular scale, each from its King profile in the Harris 2010 catalogue, with a bar beneath for the share of its stars whose light is mostly from neighbouring stars: 40 per cent in 47 Tucanae, 36 in NGC 6752 and M54, 12 in M22, 11 in omega Centauri, 7 in NGC 6397 and 3 in M4.
svg.text: STARS WHOSE LIGHT IS MOSTLY THEIR NEIGHBOURS'
share with a stellar pollution ratio above 0.5, under each cluster as it fills the one-degree field
